batch_observation.branch_takeaway: The new 504-rank sweep did not beat the existing 63-smoothing control. The closest challenger was the 126-smoothing variant, which improved turnover and margin but still trailed the control on Sharpe and Fitness. The 21-smoothing and 252-smoothing variants were weaker. There is still no visible Check Submission evidence or non-null subuniverse result, so this stays exploratory rather than candidate-ready.
